ambiguities.detail: Wing_17/Wing_19 both draw shape 95 and Pow_39/Gun_22 both draw shape 154. The renderer keeps one PNG per symbol name (identical pixels), because the runtime keys art by mcName. Whether the reuse was intentional or a 2011 copy/paste bug cannot be proven from the SWF.
UI DefineSound 637/640/677 have no SymbolClass and no SoundData call site. They are extracted byte-for-byte to Assets/Resources/Audio/Embedded and are not mapped to any screen or action.

Full-screen JPEG backdrops 5/441/511/620 sit on UI timelines but their parent screen is not recoverable from the symbol tree. They are extracted as standalone textures, kept out of every atlas, and left on a centre pivot because the manifest has no registration point for them.

Eight UI DefineMorphShape tags have no deterministic still frame and are not referenced by a section that needs a sprite. They are documented here instead of being guessed into a PNG; FFDec can export start/end frames if a later section needs the animation.

The ticket asks for 3-frame = normal/hover/pressed and 2-frame = normal/pressed. The frozen BtnBase.as uses frame 1 for up and frame 2 for both MOUSE_OVER and MOUSE_DOWN; FormBase.as uses frame 3 for the selected row state. The pipeline exports normal=f1, hover=f2, pressed=f3 for 3-frame widgets (as requested) and records the code-true state machine in each record, so a consumer can use f2 for pressed if it follows the frozen behaviour.

These 2/3-frame widgets are page bodies or full-page composites, not buttons. They are still exported with the state naming so coverage is complete, but their frame semantics are unresolved and their nine-slice border is overridden to zero.
The frozen export has 219 unique non-empty UI strings, matching research #173. Uniqueness is case-sensitive: 390 UI tags contain 388 non-empty strings.

The 230 static text tags (199 UI + 31 data) are extractable data, not raster sprites; their output is the JSON string table keyed by original text id. They are counted as extracted, with no PNG invented.

UI sprites 193 (150x150 shop/repair preview) and 314 (50x50 craft preview) are runtime-filled containers: every exported frame is fully transparent. They stay in the coverage manifest as empty records; no transparent PNG was invented, and the preview must be drawn by the Unity UI implementation.

BG1-BG4 are seamless 2000px tiles whose FFDec canvas is up to 2250x2249. They are extracted as standalone textures instead of being packed into the 2048 BackgroundsAtlas with the 23 planet/prop composites. No level-to-background or parallax map is invented; those values stay in the level data.

862 composite-only descendants (541 data + 321 UI) are children used only through their parent symbols. They are not exported as standalone files. Full-screen pages are exported whole and the 139 UI widgets are the only composites sliced out individually, because the manifest marks them standalone.

The SWF contains no explosion, smoke, spark, trail, debris or missile symbols. Effects are procedural in Particle.as; the combat atlas therefore contains the four Blt_* sprites, the baked procedural normal disc and the four pickups only.

The eight frozen fonts are embedded exactly; no substitute is used. Arial and Times New Roman are commercial subsets, SF TransRobotics/SF Zero Gravity have undocumented ShyFonts-era terms, and _sans is an unidentified generic subset. ADR 0020 accepts the risk for this non-commercial preservation build only.
